title: Configurable Form
subtitle: An antd-form-builder config-driven form: edit JSON or adjust fields visually on the left, and preview the rendering live on the right
configStructError: Invalid config structure: it must be an object containing a fields array
jsonHint: columns controls the number of columns; formItemLayout: [6,16] controls the label width ratio (set it to null for multiple columns)
emptyFields: No fields yet; add one below
keyRule: key is required, must start with a letter, and may contain digits, underscores or dots
resultEmpty: After submitting, the collected field values (JSON) appear here
widgetsNote: ★ marks custom widgets registered via FormBuilder.defineWidget(); the rest are built-in. In addition, any antd component can be passed in directly as a widget.
submitSuccess: Form submitted successfully; the result is shown below
